name: message
description: One turn of a task and answer exchange: a filled prompt panel or an outlined, right-aligned answer, with an optional label and optional inline corrections.

props.name: variant
props.description: prompt (filled bg-surface-pressed panel) or answer (outlined, right-aligned). Other values fall back to prompt.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional small uppercase caption above the text.

props.name: segments
props.description: Optional list of {text, kind?, tooltip?} replacing `text`. A segment with kind remove or add renders as an inline-mark (with its tooltip); others are plain text.

rationale: A task and the learner's reply are two voices, so they differ by shape, not only by color: the prompt is a filled panel (bg-surface-pressed), the answer is outlined with the hairline token and aligned to the right. Padding is spacing-5 for both; the text uses the body type, the label the data role in uppercase and text-subactive, so the label reads as a caption. Segments let the same box show a corrected sentence by composing inline-mark; the plain-text path covers every other case. Arrangement of messages in a column (gaps, a pinned input) is the host's layout, not part of this component. No Figma node: taken from the application's design canvas of 2026-10-21.
a11y_notes: Plain divs of text; no role. A host that shows a conversation should put the messages in a list or a log region and say who speaks (the label can carry it). Corrections come from inline-mark; see its notes on conveying removed and added text to assistive technology.
